run_simulation_demo: run the labgraph simulation demo that generates and plots daubechies wavelet cycles in real time
create_simulation_generator_node: create a labgraph node that generates SimulationMessage outputs with rotating daubechies wavelet data at a configurable sample rate
create_simulation_plot_node: create a labgraph node that subscribes to SimulationMessage and displays real-time matplotlib line plots of the data
create_simulation_function_cycles: create simulation cycles including sine, square, daubechies wavelet, and hemodynamic response function waveforms using SimulationFunction
create_labgraph_demo_graph: create a labgraph Demo graph that connects a SimulationGenerator node to a Plot node with configurable sample rate and refresh rate
